d.g: A bird of South America, Rhynchotus rufescens, the red-winged tinamou.

ynambu.e: Borrowed from Paraguayan Guarani ynambu, from Tupian inambú.

d.g: Synonym of Anglesey; especially as a parliamentary constituency.

Ynys Môn.e: Unadapted borrowing from Welsh Ynys Môn.

d.g: An esoteric Rodnover (Slavic Neopagan) sect from Russia.

Ynglism.e: Borrowed from Russian инглиизм (ingliizm). May be reanalyzed as Yngling (“a Scandinavian royal dynasty”) + -ism, in analogy with the Russian word. In Ynglist belief, the name refers to a fiery primordial radiance known as the "Ynglia" emanated by the supreme god Ramkha.

d.g: A male given name from Hebrew.
